history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - this is a Baptist church. IMPORTANT IDENTITY NOTE: 'Lunglei Baptist Church' is a generic name; Lunglei town has many Baptist Church of Mizoram (BCM) congregations (e.g. BCM Serkawn, BCM Chanmari, BCM Farm Veng, BCM Salem - verify which congregation the CSV row intends). The denomination behind all of them is the Baptist Church of Mizoram, the second-largest church in Mizoram, headquartered at Serkawn near Lunglei. BCM originates in an English Baptist mission established in 1894 by Frederick William Savidge and James Herbert Lorrain of the Baptist Missionary Society; the first church council was formed in 1914. BCM reported 663 churches and about 122,072 members in its 2023 census (verify), is affiliated with the Baptist World Alliance, and runs schools, a seminary (Academy of Integrated Christian Studies), a nursing college at Christian Hospital Serkawn and extensive mission work. The BCM Serkawn Church - established in the early 20th century by the missionaries and serving as the denominational headquarters church - is described as Lunglei's most significant religious landmark and a symbol of Christianity's arrival in southern Mizoram; the first schools and hospitals in southern Mizoram were founded at Serkawn. Local BCM congregations serve as the community and spiritual hub of their neighbourhoods, with Sunday worship, Sunday School, women's and youth fellowships, and choirs. Because the CSV name is generic, verify whether the intended congregation is one of the named Lunglei churches (e.g. Chanmari, Farm Veng) or a general reference.

name: Lunglei Baptist Church
town_description: Lunglei is the second-largest town of Mizoram and the headquarters of Lunglei district, about 165-200 km south of Aizawl. 'Lunglei' means 'bridge of rock', from a rock formation near Nghasih, a tributary of the Tlawng river. Serkawn, the historic missionary station and headquarters of the Baptist Church of Mizoram, lies adjacent to the town (verify distance); the BCM headquarters office is at Serkawn, P.O. Zotlang. Other town landmarks include Saikuti Hall, Thuamluaia Mual football stadium and the nearby Khawnglung Wildlife Sanctuary.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl, IATA: AJL) - the nearest commercial airport, about 170-200 km from Lunglei (verify); helicopter service between Aizawl and Lunglei has operated (verify current status).
travel.railway: No railway station at Lunglei; the nearest railhead is on the Bairabi-Sairang line (verify current connectivity), with onward road travel to Lunglei.
travel.road: Lunglei is about 165-200 km south of Aizawl, connected by regular buses and shared sumos/jeeps (verify timings). BCM churches are spread across the town's localities (Serkawn, Chanmari, Farm Veng, Salem); taxis and autos ply within the town.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather. Christmas season (December) is the most festive time in Mizo church life but also the busiest.
